en.name: GitHub Sync
en.description: Keeps this folder as a normal git repository on GitHub: files keep their paths, one sync makes one commit, and nothing is ever deleted without you deleting it here.
en.tab.title: GitHub
en.action.disconnect.confirm: Forget the token and the sync state of this folder? Nothing in the folder changes.
en.setup.title: Connect to GitHub
en.setup.token.hint: A fine-grained token with Contents read and write on the repository is enough. It stays on this computer.
en.first.title: Both sides have files
en.first.body: This folder holds {0} files, the repository {1}, and {2} of them differ. Which side should win?
en.first.hint: Nothing is deleted either way: the side that loses keeps its files in the same commit.
en.conflict.title: Changed on both sides
en.conflict.hint: Pick one answer per file; the version that loses goes to .trash, so nothing is lost.
en.settings.autoPush.hint: Saves are collected first: one commit, not one per keystroke.
en.settings.autoPull.hint: Only when this folder has nothing to send.
en.settings.settle: Seconds to wait after a save
en.settings.settle.hint: Longer means fewer commits while typing.
en.settings.onRemoteDelete: When a file is gone from GitHub
en.settings.conflictPolicy: When a file changed on both sides
en.settings.maxSize.hint: GitHub refuses a single file over 100 MB; the plugin stops at 32 MB per file.
en.settings.rules.hint: One per line, like .gitignore: a path, a folder ending in /, or a pattern; start a line with ! to keep what was excluded. File types are not filtered — whatever the rules do not exclude is synced.
en.settings.tooLarge: {0} files are larger than the limit and stay on this computer:
en.settings.excluded: {0} files are left out by the rules
en.error.auth: GitHub did not accept the token. Check that it can read and write the repository's contents.
en.error.rateLimit: GitHub's request limit is reached. It comes back within the hour.
en.error.notFound: GitHub could not find the repository, the branch or the token's access to them.
en.error.conflict: The branch moved while syncing. Run sync again.
en.error.nonFastForward: The branch moved while syncing. Run sync again.
en.error.server: GitHub is having trouble right now. Try again later.
en.error.truncated: The repository's file list is too large to list in one go. Narrow the rules.
en.error.network: Could not reach GitHub. Check the network, the proxy and the token.
en.error.noFolder: Open a folder first: sync keeps one folder.
en.error.repoMissing: Fill in the owner and the repository name.

zh.name: GitHub 同步
zh.description: 把这个文件夹当作 GitHub 上的普通 git 仓库同步：路径不变、一次同步一个提交，你不在这里删，任何文件都不会被删。
zh.tab.title: GitHub
zh.status.pending: {0} 个待推送，{1} 个待拉取
zh.action.disconnect.confirm: 忘记这台电脑上的令牌和同步记录？文件夹里的内容不会被改动。
zh.setup.title: 连接 GitHub
zh.setup.token.hint: 细粒度令牌给出该仓库的 Contents 读写权限就够用。令牌只保存在这台电脑上。
zh.first.title: 两边都有文件
zh.first.body: 这个文件夹有 {0} 个文件，仓库有 {1} 个，其中 {2} 个不同。以哪边为准？
zh.first.hint: 无论选哪边都不会丢文件：落败的一边会原样保留在同一个提交里。
zh.sync.last: 上次同步 {0}：发出 {1} 个，收到 {2} 个
zh.sync.quota: GitHub 本小时剩余 {0} 次请求
zh.sync.done: 发出 {0} 个，收到 {1} 个，跳过 {2} 个
zh.conflict.title: 两边都改过的文件
zh.conflict.hint: 每个文件选一种处理方式；输掉的那份会进 .trash，不会丢。
zh.settings.autoPush.hint: 会先攒一会儿：一次提交，而不是每敲一下就提交。
zh.settings.autoPull.hint: 只在本文件夹没有要推送的内容时拉取。
zh.settings.settle.hint: 等得久一点，打字过程中产生的提交就少一点。
zh.settings.maxSize.hint: GitHub 单个文件上限 100 MB；插件自己在 32 MB 就停下。
zh.settings.rules.hint: 每行一条，写法同 .gitignore：路径、以 / 结尾的文件夹、或通配模式；行首加 ! 可以把排除的内容重新包含进来。不按文件类型过滤——规则没排除的都同步。
zh.settings.tooLarge: {0} 个文件超过大小上限，留在本机：
zh.error.auth: GitHub 没有接受这个令牌。确认它能读写该仓库的内容。
zh.error.rateLimit: 已达 GitHub 的请求上限，一小时内会恢复。
zh.error.notFound: GitHub 找不到这个仓库、分支，或令牌无权访问。
zh.error.conflict: 同步途中分支被更新了，再同步一次即可。
zh.error.nonFastForward: 同步途中分支被更新了，再同步一次即可。
zh.error.server: GitHub 现在有问题，稍后再试。
zh.error.truncated: 仓库的文件列表太大，一次列不完，请把规则收窄一些。
zh.error.network: 连不上 GitHub。检查网络、代理和令牌。
zh.error.noFolder: 请先打开一个文件夹：同步只维护一个文件夹。
zh.error.repoMissing: 请填写用户名和仓库名。
